name: The Oregonian / OregonLive editorial board
lean_basis: Largest Oregon daily. Its editorial board has endorsed candidates of both parties for statewide office over the past decade and endorsed in the May 2026 Republican primary for governor. Whether it has published Nov. 2026 general-election endorsements was not confirmed as of Oct. 16.

name: Willamette Week endorsements
lean_basis: Portland alt-weekly. Publishes an endorsement issue every election after candidate interviews; picks skew progressive but it regularly backs moderates and endorsed in the May 2026 GOP primary for governor. Its Nov. 2026 issue had not been located as of Oct. 16; it usually lands the second half of October.

name: Portland Mercury endorsements
lean_basis: Portland alt-weekly whose editorial endorsements are openly progressive.

name: League of Women Voters of Oregon (VOTE411)
lean_basis: Nonpartisan. Does not endorse or oppose candidates. Takes positions on ballot measures only when they match adopted League policy. There are no statewide measures in Nov. 2026.

name: Democratic Party of Oregon
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its 2026 State Voters' Pamphlet statement names the candidates it is working to elect.

name: Oregon Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its 2026 State Voters' Pamphlet statement urges 'VOTE REPUBLICAN' without naming candidates.

name: Oregon AFL-CIO (Oregon Labor Federation)
lean_basis: State labor federation; endorses overwhelmingly Democratic candidates.

name: Planned Parenthood Action Fund / PP PAC of Oregon
lean_basis: Abortion-rights advocacy PAC; endorses candidates who support abortion access, nearly all Democrats.

name: Sierra Club Oregon Chapter
lean_basis: Environmental advocacy group; endorsements go almost entirely to Democrats. Publishes a 2026 General Election Candidate Endorsements page.

name: Oregon Coalition of Police & Sheriffs (ORCOPS)
lean_basis: Statewide law-enforcement association that endorses candidates; has backed candidates of both parties but more often Republicans in statewide races.

name: Oregon Farm Bureau PAC
lean_basis: Statewide agriculture trade association; its PAC endorses mostly Republicans and some rural Democrats.

name: Oregon Right to Life PAC
lean_basis: Anti-abortion advocacy group; endorses candidates who oppose abortion, nearly all Republicans.

name: Oregon Firearms Federation PAC
lean_basis: Gun-rights group that rates and endorses candidates, nearly all Republicans.
